svg.aria-label: The problem: top-deck one card, when the game lets you
svg.title: The problem: top-deck one card, when the game lets you
svg.text: The problem: top-deck one card, when the game lets you
Catching the Power Nut = drawing your chosen card from 51. You draw by casting; you pull in only at a bite, with 0.33 s to let go.
1 · Press B: the game frame you press on picks the cast
each card = a cast on that frame (1/30 s apart);
face up = the Power Nut is its 1st bite.
A frame earlier or later is another cast,
2 · Hold B. Each bite lights one card for 0.33 s: let go then, or the line comes back empty
Three casts a frame apart. Gold bars = the 0.33 s windows (20 refreshes); early, late or held through = not that card.
3 · One cast per attempt: whatever it brings, the next try is a new arrival, a new deck (another dog line).
Cast blind and the Nut is the 1st bite on 22 of 1,197 cast frames in the first 40 s (1.8%). The tool counts you down
to the frame to press on, and tells you which bite to let go at.
Real data: L1 of Sunny → No horse (14% of arrivals), three real casts one game frame apart and their bites (cast pack); time = seconds after Jack stops.
